subject.title: macOS update can leave manual-update loop and stale node host causing Gateway restart storm

question: Should #87928 remain the canonical tracker for the macOS manualupdate launchd restart-loop family, or should maintainers split the remaining work into narrower launchd cleanup, no-op update, health-proof, and node-host recovery issues?
rationale: The remaining work crosses macOS service lifecycle policy, stale-job ownership, no-op update behavior, and live launchd proof, and the item already carries product-decision/no-new-fix-pr/live-repro gates.

options.title: Keep canonical with live proof
options.body: Keep #87928 open as the canonical issue and require any fix to prove stale-job cleanup, no-op update behavior, and post-update Gateway health on real macOS launchd.

options.title: Split narrower follow-ups
options.body: Split the remaining symptoms into separate issues for manualupdate label cleanup, same-version update no-op policy, LaunchAgent health recovery, and node-host stale recovery, then close this only after the split is linked.

options.title: Close after smoke proof
options.body: Close only if current main or a shipped release passes a real macOS update smoke that demonstrates the observed manualupdate loop and stale node/gateway symptoms no longer occur.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical with live proof
recommendation.body: Keep #87928 open as the canonical issue and require any fix to prove stale-job cleanup, no-op update behavior, and post-update Gateway health on real macOS launchd.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent update/launchd service-state work is closest to the cross-surface policy and upgrade behavior still needed here.
